scope: Historical lab implementation; not full-model qualification of current upstream

review_repair.subject: expert_cache.py lease() recorded the eviction-gating CUDA event on the stream current at RELEASE, not on the stream that owned the lease
review_repair.original_extraction_sha256_verified_from: git show 44954eb:experiments/dsv41_nvme/expert_cache.py | sha256sum (the pre-repair blob in this repository, an exclusive clone)
review_repair.what_changed: one line added in the acquisition block (owning_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device)) and one call site changed in the release path (event.record(owning_stream) instead of event.record(torch.cuda.current_stream(self.device))), plus a docstring on lease() that states the stream contract and the consumer obligation
review_repair.design_note: the owning stream is a per-LEASE local, deliberately NOT a field on Entry: an Entry can be leased concurrently by several callers on different streams, so a shared field would let the last writer decide every lease's gating event
review_repair.what_did_not_change: arena ownership, Regions allocation/release arithmetic, capacity/layer-quota checks, the host RAM and swap gate, hit/miss/eviction accounting, the completed-event drop on the hit path, the cache lock discipline, the ordering of event-record before users-decrement, and every other module: bytes and cache behaviour are preserved
review_repair.contract_now_enforced_documentedly: the consumer must run the lease body on the stream captured at acquisition (normally by acquiring inside torch.cuda.stream(s)) and must not switch streams inside the body; _evict() then synchronizes an event that does carry a happens-before edge to the consumer's kernels even when the caller releases after its stream block has exited
review_repair.evidence_cpu: experiments/dsv41_nvme/test_lease_stream_contract.py (4 checks, CPU, torch.cuda replaced by a recording test double): 3/4 fail against the pre-repair blob 7f03bf12 and 4/4 pass against the repaired blob
review_repair.evidence_cpu_scope: contract-level only; the double records which stream object each event is recorded on and makes no CUDA call, so it is not GPU evidence
review_repair.evidence_gpu: experiments/dsv41_nvme/test_lease_stream_cuda.py is prepared and GATED (DSV41_NVME_CUDA_CONTRACT=1 plus a device) but NOT RUN on this host: no CUDA receipt is claimed for the repair
review_repair.qualification_status: UNQUALIFIED on hardware: run the opt-in fixture on a GPU host before any serving promotion
